_comment: Scripted-input demo: click-select the Spearmen (uid 0, spawned at ~120,232.5 on seed 12345), then right-drag a flank line to deploy them. Driven through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. Coordinates are world-space; ticks are physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: The clip deliberately films a large formation reshape at the new pitch identity; in-transit samples fire the grid metrics (same-owner bodies pass arbitrarily close mid-re-slot by design -- intra-regiment spacing is the formation arrival's job, not steering's -- and routes cross while the grid re-deals). Measured on the new-density re-pin: min neighbour 0.26 wu during the drag-line re-deal.
